refine.en: On an anvil, put a Halia Blade in the left slot and a soul material in the right slot. Each piece used repairs the blade's wear and raises its refine by 1, for 1 experience level per piece; pieces are used until the wear is gone. The material sets the highest refine it can reach: Tiny Corvus Soul 10, Corvus Soul 50, Soulsteel Ingot 100, Corvus Core 150, Corvus Crystal 200, Abyssal Geode no limit.
refine.ja: 金床の左に刀、右に魂の素材を置きます。素材 1 個ごとに刀の損耗が直り、強化回数が 1 上がります。経験値レベルは 1 個につき 1 で、損耗がなくなるまで素材を使います。強化回数の上限は素材で決まります: コルヴスの魂片 10、コルヴスの魂 50、魂鋼のインゴット 100、コルヴスの核 150、コルヴスの結晶 200、深淵の晶洞は上限なし。

creative_tab.why: The 31 recipes under data/halia/recipe/creative_tab/ (11 in 1.1.0, and 20 under creative_tab/v12/ in 1.2.0) cannot be crafted: their only ingredient is the tag halia:namedsoul, whose only value is minecraft:air, which no item in a crafting grid matches. The mod reads those files only to list finished blades in its creative tab.
